parsed.notes: Reviewed under lens B only. I did not assess support or quote fidelity except where wording created a currency/treatment risk.

reasons: The lake identity record confirms the case name, U.S. Supreme Court court field, docket, date decided, year, and cluster id.
The lake citation record contains the official citation 494 U.S. 259 and the listed parallel and vendor citations.
residual_risks: The disclosed treatment record is unverified, so this confirms identity/citation existence only, not affirmative good-law currency.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the visible Treatment: Unverified disclaimer adjacent to the citation when presenting this authority.

defect.evidence_quote: Frontier stub: treatment/progeny intentionally not derived until S6 promotion.
defect.problem: The role 'Key — Anchor (foreign search)' implies current anchor status, but the disclosed lake record has no verified treatment or progeny derivation to support that currency claim.
defect.proposed_fix: Qualify the role as editorial or historical pending S6 treatment/progeny verification, or downgrade/remove the current-law anchor implication.

reasons: The lake treatment composite_basis is unverified and as_of_treatment is null.
The progeny fields show no complete query, no citation count, and rows_cached 0.
residual_risks: The role may be substantively true, but it is not verifiable from the disclosed record under lens B.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'Key — Historical Anchor (treatment unverified)' unless a verified citator/progeny record supports the stronger role.

defect.problem: The holding is framed in present-tense legal-rule form, but the disclosed treatment record does not verify that the rule remains live law; support or quote accuracy is not assessed under this lens.
defect.proposed_fix: Reframe as a historical holding, e.g. 'The Court held in 1990...', or provide verified treatment/progeny fields establishing current good-law status.

reasons: The lake record provides no verified good-law judgment: field_i_validity and composite_basis are unverified.
The lake treatment edges and progeny outbound_opinion_edges arrays are empty, with no derivation supplied.
residual_risks: Lens A would still need to assess historical support and quote fidelity from opinion text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Mark the holding as historical unless and until treatment is promoted from unverified.

reasons: The content treatment fields match the lake treatment record: field_i_validity unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, composite_basis unverified, composite_basis_ref null, and varies_by_point false.
The scope note in content matches the lake scope note.
residual_risks: The treatment status is itself unverified; it should not be used as affirmative good-law confirmation.

defect.problem: The SCOTUS source-weight component is supported by the lake court_level, but the word 'Binding' can be read as a current good-law conclusion, which the disclosed unverified treatment record does not establish.
defect.proposed_fix: Render the label so source weight and treatment are separated, e.g. 'SCOTUS — Treatment Unverified,' or reserve 'Binding' for authorities with verified live-law treatment.

reasons: The lake identity record identifies the court as U.S. and court_level as scotus.
No disclosed record supersedes or overrules the case, but the treatment fields are expressly unverified.
residual_risks: If 'Binding — SCOTUS' is defined only as court-hierarchy source weight, the current label is materially correct; the risk is reader confusion with good-law status.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Pair or replace the label with explicit treatment status wherever it renders.
